PURPOSE:  THE PURPOSE OF THIS PROJECT IS TO PROVIDE SERVICES TO EXPAND EXISTING MEP CAPABILITIES TO PROVIDE NATIONAL SUPPLY CHAIN OPTIMIZATION AND TO ESTABLISH A SUPPLY CHAIN INTELLIGENCE NETWORK.  IMPROVE THE RESILIENCY AND OPTIMIZATION FOR DOMESTIC SUPPLY CHAINS IN THE MEP NATIONAL NETWORK IN THE STATE OF ARIZONA.ACTIVITIES TO BE PERFORMED: HIRE A FULL TIME DIRECTOR OF SUPPLY CHAIN OPTIMIZATION, EXPANDING THE SUPPLIER SCOUTING PROGRAM, PERFORMING A DETAILED ASSESSMENT OF THE MANUFACTURING CAPABILITIES ACROSS THE STATE, COLLECTING AND ANALYZING DATA TO THOROUGHLY DESCRIBE THE ARIZONA MANUFACTURING ECOSYSTEM, IDENTIFYING GAPS IN THE SUPPLY CHAINS FOR KEY INDUSTRIES (E.G., SEMICONDUCTORS), AND UNDERSTANDING THE RISKS AND IMPLICATIONS TO NATIONAL SECURITY (E.G., AEROSPACE AND DEFENSE SUPPLIERS), AND PARTNERING WITH A NATIONAL SUPPLY CHAIN DATABASE FIRM (E.G., SUSTAINMENT, CONNEX, ETC.).   EXPECTED OUTCOMES: 1) AN EXPANDED SUPPLIER SCOUTING PROGRAM THAT PROCESSES A SIGNIFICANTLY HIGHER VOLUME OF REQUESTS AND GUARANTEES A RESPONSE TO EACH AND EVERY REQUEST, 2) A DETAILED UNDERSTANDING OF THE ARIZONA MANUFACTURING ECOSYSTEM, INCLUDING CAPABILITIES AND APPROXIMATE PRODUCTION CAPACITIES OF ARIZONA MANUFACTURERS, 3) AN ARIZONA SUPPLY CHAIN INTELLIGENCE NETWORK THAT SERVES AS AN INTEGRAL NODE IN THE NATIONAL SUPPLY CHAIN INTELLIGENCE NETWORK, 4) TRAINING PROGRAMS FOR SMMS TO HELP THEM STRENGTHEN THEIR SUPPLY CHAIN OPERATIONS, AND 5) A SET OF SUPPLY CHAIN SERVICES TO SUPPORT SMM EFFORTS TO IMPROVE SUPPLY CHAIN OPERATIONS, ADD RESILIENCY, AND EXPAND DOMESTIC PRODUCTION AND USE OF DOMESTIC SUPPLIERS.   INTENDED BENEFICIARIES: SMALL AND MEDIUM-SIZED MANUFACTURERS (SMMS) IN THE STATE OF ARIZONA.SUBRECIPIENT ACTIVITIES: THE RECIPIENT DOES NOT INTEND TO SUBAWARD FUNDS.

PURPOSE:  THE PURPOSE OF THIS PROJECT IS TO PROVIDE SERVICES TO EXPAND EXISTING MEP CAPABILITIES TO PROVIDE NATIONAL SUPPLY CHAIN OPTIMIZATION AND TO ESTABLISH A SUPPLY CHAIN INTELLIGENCE NETWORK.  IMPROVE THE RESILIENCY AND OPTIMIZATION FOR DOMESTIC SUPPLY CHAINS IN THE MEP NATIONAL NETWORK IN THE STATE OF MISSOURI.ACTIVITIES TO BE PERFORMED: THE EXPANSION AWARD WILL PROVIDE FUNDING FOR A DEDICATED FULL-TIME EMPLOYEE TO MANAGE AND DELIVER SUPPLY CHAIN, UTILIZE THE CONNEX SUPPLY CHAIN DATABASE; CONNEX MISSOURI, UPDATING AND FACILITATING THE EXECUTION OF THE CONNEX SUPPLY CHAIN MARKETING PLAN. THE PLAN WILL INCLUDE MARKETING STRATEGIES AS WELL AS KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS TO ENSURE COMMITMENT AND SUCCESS OF THE PLAN. OUR ENGAGEMENT WILL INCLUDE HELPING MANUFACTURERS WITH THEIR NEEDS BY HELPING WITH BUILDING A PROFESSIONAL PROFILE TO DRIVE CUSTOMER AND POTENTIAL SUPPLIER INTEREST. WORK TO UNDERSTAND THE BEST WAY TO MAP AS MANY SUPPLY CHAINS AS POSSIBLE TO BEST UNDERSTAND SUPPLY CHAIN DISRUPTIONS, DISCONNECTS AND DELAYS.    EXPECTED OUTCOMES: RESULTS FROM WORK PROVIDED THROUGH THIS EXPANSION FUNDING WILL PROVIDE MANUFACTURERS WITH INCREASED VISIBILITY AND ACCESS TO MULTIPLE SOURCES OF SUPPLIERS ENABLING THEM TO IMPROVE MANY OF THE DISRUPTIONS AND DISCONNECTS THEY MAY BE EXPERIENCING IN THEIR SUPPLY CHAIN. MANUFACTURERS WILL BE ABLE TO SOURCE ALTERNATE SUPPLIERS FOR COST COMPARISONS, QUALITY CERTIFICATIONS, BUSINESS TYPE, VENDOR CAPABILITIES, DELIVERY ENHANCEMENTS, AND DESIGN IMPROVEMENTS THAT LEAD TO IMPACTS SUCH AS QUALITY IMPROVEMENTS.INTENDED BENEFICIARIES: SMALL AND MEDIUM-SIZED MANUFACTURERS (SMMS) IN THE STATE OF MISSOURI.SUBRECIPIENT ACTIVITIES: THE RECIPIENT DOES NOT INTEND TO SUBAWARD FUNDS.

PURPOSE:  THE PURPOSE OF THIS PROJECT IS TO PROVIDE SERVICES TO EXPAND EXISTING MEP CAPABILITIES TO PROVIDE NATIONAL SUPPLY CHAIN OPTIMIZATION AND TO ESTABLISH A SUPPLY CHAIN INTELLIGENCE NETWORK.  IMPROVE THE RESILIENCY AND OPTIMIZATION FOR DOMESTIC SUPPLY CHAINS IN THE MEP NATIONAL NETWORK IN THE STATE OF WISCONSIN.ACTIVITIES TO BE PERFORMED: THE EXPANSION AWARD WILL ALLOW WCMP TO IDENTIFY GAPS IN THE WISCONSIN SUPPLY CHAIN AND FIND SOLUTIONS TO HELP THEIR SMALL- AND MEDIUM-SIZED MANUFACTURERS (SMMS) BECOME MORE RESILIENT. THEY WILL FOLLOW TWO TRACKS WITH THIS PROJECT: ACTIVELY PARTICIPATE IN SUPPLIER SCOUTING AND NATIONAL NETWORK SUPPLY CHAIN INITIATIVES; AND PROACTIVELY ENGAGE WITH PARTNERS TO UNDERSTAND GAPS IN WISCONSINS SUPPLY CHAIN AND CREATE NEW SOLUTIONS TO FILL THOSE GAPS.EXPECTED OUTCOMES: AT THE CONCLUSION OF THIS PROJECT, THE WCMP WILL UNDERSTAND AND DOCUMENT THE STRENGTHS OF AND GAPS IN THE WISCONSIN SUPPLY CHAIN. THE WCMP WILL ALSO IDENTIFY OPPORTUNITIES FOR WISCONSIN MANUFACTURERS TO SUPPORT NATIONAL SUPPLY CHAIN NEEDS. THE WISCONSIN SUPPLY CHAIN INTELLIGENCE GAINED THROUGH THIS PROJECT WILL HELP STATE PARTNERS AS THEY CRAFT AND EXECUTE A STATEWIDE MANUFACTURING STRATEGY. IT WILL ALSO BENEFIT WISCONSINS ORIGINAL   EQUIPMENT MANUFACTURERS (OEMS) THROUGH IMPROVED KNOWLEDGE AND VISIBILITY TO MANUFACTURING CAPABILITIES WITHIN THE STATE. WISCONSINS SMMS WILL ALSO BE SERVED AS SUPPLIER OPTIONS ARE MORE VISIBLE AND BUSINESS OPPORTUNITIES ARISE AS LARGER MANUFACTURERS SEEK TO LOCALIZE AND DIVERSIFY THEIR SUPPLY CHAINS.INTENDED BENEFICIARIES: SMALL AND MEDIUM-SIZED MANUFACTURERS (SMMS) IN THE STATE OF WISCONSIN.SUBRECIPIENT ACTIVITIES: WCMPS LONG-TERM SUBRECIPIENTS, THE WMEP AND THE UW-STOUT MANUFACTURING OUTREACH CENTER, WILL PROVIDE FRONT-LINE SUPPORT FOR SUPPLY CHAIN ACTIVITIES. THIS WILL BE ADJACENT TO THEIR CORE OFFERINGS.

IMPROVE THE RESILIENCY AND OPTIMIZATION FOR DOMESTIC SUPPLY CHAINS IN THE MEP NATIONAL NETWORK? IN THE STATE OF WASHINGTON.ACTIVITIES TO BE PERFORMED: IMPACT WASHINGTON WILL HIRE ONE FULL-TIME EMPLOYEE (FTE) TO BE THE SINGLE POINT OF CONTACT FOR THE SUPPLY CHAIN OPTIMIZATION AND INTELLIGENCE NETWORK. THIS EMPLOYEE WILL PARTICIPATE IN THE NATIONAL NETWORK, STUDY AND DOCUMENT SUPPLY CHAIN INTELLIGENCE, SUGGEST SOLUTIONS TO STORE SUPPLY CHAIN DATA, RESPOND TO ALL SUPPLIER SCOUTING REQUESTS, AND ENSURE THE CYBERSECURITY OF ALL DATA COLLECTED. AFTER FUNDING OUR FULL-TIME SUPPLY CHAIN OPTIMIZATION EMPLOYEE, CENTER WILL USE THE REMAINING FUNDS TO MODIFY OUR EXISTING SALESFORCE CUSTOMER RELATIONSHIP MANAGEMENT (CRM) TO TEMPORARILY HOUSE OUR SUPPLY CHAIN DATA AND EVALUATE THE PURCHASE OF SOME MAPPING SOFTWARE.EXPECTED OUTCOMES: THE CENTER IS TAKING A PROACTIVE APPROACH TO STRENGTHENING LOCAL SUPPLY CHAINS BY IMPLEMENTING NEW SYSTEMS THAT SUPPORT SUPPLIER SCOUTING AND OPTIMIZATION. THIS INITIATIVE INVOLVES INVESTING IN STAFF AND SUPPORT SYSTEMS TO EXPAND THE CENTER'S REACH TO INCLUDE A MORE SIGNIFICANT NUMBER OF UNIQUE AND INNOVATIVE MANUFACTURERS. THE GOAL IS TO STIMULATE ECONOMIC GROWTH AND SUSTAINABILITY IN THE LOCAL COMMUNITY BY GENERATING INCREASED SALES, JOB CREATION, COST SAVINGS, AND INVESTMENTS. THE CENTER'S NEW SYSTEMS ARE EXPECTED TO SIGNIFICANTLY ENHANCE ITS ABILITY TO RESPOND TO MEP SUPPLIER SCOUTING REQUESTS AND SERVE UNIQUE AND NEW MANUFACTURERS. THIS INITIATIVE AIMS TO IMPROVE THE RESILIENCY AND OPTIMIZATION OF THE LOCAL SUPPLY CHAIN ECOSYSTEM, WHICH IS ESSENTIAL FOR PROMOTING ECONOMIC GROWTH AND SUSTAINABILITY.
